name: Slack Desk
description: Builds memory from your Slack conversations and surfaces anything that looks like a task you missed. Reads only — it never posts.
_comment: Runs OUT OF PROCESS, spawned by app-process.ts like any marketplace app: own port, own store, reachable only over the lifecycle and data seams. Built entirely on @flock/app-sdk, which the PLATFORM supplies into node_modules at build time — its correct version is whatever this Flock build speaks, so it is not resolved from a registry.

agent.label: Agent that reads your Slack and remembers what matters

routines.name: Build memory from Slack
routines.description: Once a day, reads the channels you chose and remembers what matters — plus anything that reads like a task you have not done. No AI cost beyond the daily extraction; nothing is ever posted.
routines._triggerComment: schedule + app-relay (executor: cron.ts dispatchScheduledAppRelays). NOT event + app-relay: this app fetches its own Slack data through /apps/:id/skill-exec, so a platform connector poll on its behalf would be a second read of the same messages.

configSchema.label: How far back to read each day (hours)
